drafts.subject: chr:entity:marcus-vipsanius-agrippa
drafts.quotation: while Agrippa had full charge of the entire conflict at sea
drafts.rationale: Agrippa is Marcus Vipsanius Agrippa, Caesar's admiral. Having full charge of the whole conflict at sea is read as command exercised over Caesar's fleet as a whole. The passage does not say what formal authority he held, so I drafted commanded, not heldAuthorityOver.
drafts.relevance: Shows who held overall command of Octavian's naval force at Actium, above the wing commanders.
